More than 10,000 Firestore document reads in 5 minutes (about 2,000 a minute). In the 30 days before Nov 21, 2026 the busiest 5 minutes had 3,193; the Nov 20 client loop read about 16,000 a minute. Usually a client stuck in a loop, or a query or job reading whole collections.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Un-cliente-en-bucle-%28desde-el-20-nov-2026%29).
